answer: Reaching the raven of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. The design leans on reputation decay for idle identities, slashed on a failed audit, the unit of trust is a task, not an address. Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. Work waits on the quartz until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the island of the next round.
